name: Composite navy (BUMK 515 skeleton, MBA 630 palette, BUMG 660 headings)

provenance.composed: 2026-10-07, on the owner's direction: take the best of BUMK 515, MBA 630, and BUMG 660, with the darker navy branding and less ostentation, as the generic builder's page style

sources.bumk515_classic/page.css: skeleton, section rhythm, video wrap, details/summary, back to top, external-link mark, timeline markup
sources.MBA 630 workspace/design/scenario/fronte: palette (#174b5c brand, #103945 brand dark, #075f7a link, #edf4f6 soft, #c7d8dc border, #4b626b muted, #a55b16 focus), top bar, h2 rule, table header row, link weight
sources.BUMG 660 workspace/Overview Pages-Comple: headings in brand dark at weight 600 and line-height 1.2, +/- summary marker

provenance.left_out: MBA 630 overview and resources hero cards, evidence buttons, shadows, large radii; BUMG 660 shadowed panels and eyebrow/subtitle/lede header; BUMK 515 19px root size and 1.65 line-height
provenance.note: Page surface only. Editor fields are plain semantic HTML by default (build setting fragment_styles); the optional fragment styles below are not applied unless a build asks for them.

optional_styles_not_applied.note: A modest set for a build that sets fragment_styles to template. The renderer reads only the styles key, so these are inert until copied there.
optional_styles_not_applied.callout: border: 1px solid #d9e4e6; border-left: .3rem solid #174b5c; background: #edf4f6; padding: .9rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 4px; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
optional_styles_not_applied.td: border: 1px solid #d9e4e6; padding: .55rem .7rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left;

open_design_note: Selected by build setting template: composite-navy. Not the default until the owner says so. Page Kit borrowings 13a to 13e are not in this template; see docs/TEMPLATE_COMPOSITE_NAVY.md.
